title: Prosperity for some, ruin for others
literal_meaning: For some, the month of Pusha; for others, utter ruin.
meaning_odia: ଏକ ସମୟରେ କାହାର ସୁଖ ଓ ସମୃଦ୍ଧି, ଆଉ କାହାର ବଡ଼ ବିପତ୍ତି। ପୁଷ ମାସର ଧନଧାନ୍ୟର ଭାବ ସହ ସର୍ବନାଶକୁ ରଖି ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଅବସ୍ଥାର ତାରତମ୍ୟ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Different people can experience the same period in radically different ways. Pusha stands for a fortunate, plentiful time, while the other half names total ruin. The inspected source gloss emphasizes this disparity in circumstances.
usage_example: A sudden change in demand brings one business a busy season while another loses its customers. Someone uses the saying to describe the opposite outcomes. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The month name carries an association with grain and prosperity. Its rhyme with ସର୍ବନାଶ places abundance beside devastation, compressing a large difference in experience into two short lines.

graphic.caption: An imagined market day brings abundance to one stall and disappointment to another.

odia_summary: ସେହି ସମୟରେ କାହାକୁ ସମୃଦ୍ଧି, କାହାକୁ ବିପତ୍ତି।
english_summary: The same period can bring prosperity to some and ruin to others.
